title: Closed knight's tours with 7.5 n + O(1) crossings
scope: For every even n >= 30 an explicit closed knight's tour of the n x n board with exactly 7.5 n + 13 crossings. No claim about the least number of crossings.
gate_basis: crossing_tours.py (Python standard library) builds every tour from the description of the paper, checks that it is one closed knight's tour and counts its crossings in exact integer arithmetic: every even n from 30 to 500 (and 1000, 1002, 2000) has 7.5 n + 13 crossings; --joins checks Lemma 6 and Table 2 on the tours for 30 <= n <= 300; --arith checks the arithmetic of Lemma 7 for 30 <= n <= 3000; --patterns compares with a second construction for 40 <= n <= 500. Logs are in evidence/logs/. Two independent AI referee passes; the first rebuilt the tours from the text. No external review.
dependencies: OR-Tools (CP-SAT) for the search programs in evidence/search/; matplotlib for draw_figures.py.
limitations: Not externally peer reviewed. Checks so far: a stand-alone verification program, and two independent AI referee passes on 2026-11-17. First pass: an AI agent given only the text and the tour files rebuilt the tours with its own programs for every even n from 40 to 700 and for six larger n up to 2002, found the same tours move for move and no error in the construction; it asked for explicit tables of joins and passes in place of a sketched induction, and noticed that one set of patches serves every n >= 30. Second pass: another AI agent checked Sections 3-4 against the program and judged the proof complete after minor fixes, which were applied (full lists of the ends of the strands, a counting argument that every cell near the walls lies on one join, the boxes of the induction named, and a direct proof that the joins form a single cycle); it also ran the arithmetic check up to n = 10000.

Computer-assisted. The list of joins between the lines of the field is checked by program for 30 <= n <= 54 and proved for larger n by induction from n - 2 to n (the joins near the patches are translates); that these joins form one cycle is proved directly; the program also checks every even n from 30 to 500, and n = 1000, 1002, 2000, directly, the list of joins on the tours up to n = 300, and the arithmetic of the passes up to n = 3000. The 179 cells of the patches were found by the CP-SAT solver.

Only an upper bound. The least number of crossings lies between 4n - O(1) (Besa et al.) and 7.5 n + 13; the right constant is open. The remarks on what a solver finds for single walls are reports of computations, not theorems, and are not used in the proof.
Knuth's exercise is quoted from the draft of 8 May 2026 (checked on 2026-11-17 against the copy of fasc8a.ps.gz in the Internet Archive). The draft is cited, not reproduced.
Whether the result is new was checked only by a literature search (no later improvement of Besa et al. was found). Priority has not been established by an external party.
